purpose: Negative control. The site itself is server-rendered HTML with no client-side data transport at all, so a correct elimination table here is almost entirely absent rows. It also tests the public-API gate at its hardest: two fully documented APIs sit beside a site that uses neither.

transports.note: Absent. Data is in the markup as ordinary table rows, not as a payload.

transports.evidence: Measured by driving the browser here on 2026-07-29. The only transport. Two call shapes total.
Found by a discovery run and verified end to end. Vote and comment forms exist in the DOM; unreachable without an account.
transports.note: Vote and comment forms are in the DOM and the classifier can emit this row — but exercising it needs an account, and the sweep will not submit a form in any case. Detectability is a property of the tool; reachability is a property of the target and the session. Conflating them makes a row that cannot be reached here look like a row the tool cannot see anywhere.

publicApis.note: Official, documented, and NOT what the site's front end calls. Wrapping it is the public-API gate failure.
Third-party search index over the same content. Same caveat.
